title: French Savory Pie
description: A classic French savory pie filled with vegetables and cheese, perfect for a light and satisfying meal.
instructions: Roll out the pie crust and place it in a pie dish.
In a pan, sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook until tender.
Stir in the shredded cheese and dried thyme.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Pour the vegetable mixture into the pie crust.
Roll out the remaining pie crust to fit the top of the pie.
Crisscross the top crust with a knife and bake for 35-40 minutes.
